title: Phase 7 Command Classification
description: Validates a non-executing Phase 7 command classification record. This schema classifies command intent before execution; it does not execute commands, call providers, mutate runtime state, trigger deployments or replace human approval.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this command classification schema contract.

classificationId.description: Deterministic, id-safe identifier for this classification record. The value must not contain local machine paths, secrets or provider identifiers.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp for when the classification record was created.

commandCategory.description: High-level category of the requested command intent.

riskLevel.description: Risk level assigned before any command execution is considered.

executionClass.description: Non-executing classification of the command boundary.

requiresHumanApproval.description: Whether explicit human approval is required before any downstream action may proceed.

providerSensitivity.description: Provider interaction sensitivity for the classified command intent.

runtimeSensitivity.description: Runtime interaction sensitivity for the classified command intent.

allowedActions.description: Explicit non-executing actions allowed within this classification boundary.

forbiddenActions.description: Explicit actions that are forbidden for this classification, including execution, provider, deployment, runtime mutation or unsafe Git operations where relevant.

blockedStates.description: States that block the command from advancing without execution.

safetyNotes.description: Human-readable safety notes for review. Notes must not include secrets, tokens, provider credentials or executable instructions.

nonExecutableMetadata.description: Review and traceability metadata only. This object must not contain executable instructions, shell commands, provider calls, deployment actions, secrets, tokens, real provider IDs or local machine paths.

source.description: Optional source context for the classification record.

userIntentSummary.description: Optional concise summary of the user intent being classified.

approvalReason.description: Optional reason human approval is required.

reviewStatus.description: Optional lifecycle status for human review of the classification.

reviewedBy.description: Optional reviewer identifier. This must not contain secrets, tokens or local machine paths.

reviewedAt.description: Optional UTC timestamp for when the classification was reviewed.
